title: PR #63: docs: implement MASTER-ARCH-001 system completeness contract
content:
State: open
Merged: False
Draft: False

## Summary

Implements MASTER-ARCH-001 as the canonical system-wide architecture contract.

### Implemented

- System-of-Systems scope and layer model
- Repository / SSOT contract
- Authority matrix and authority invariants
- Identity / trust model
- Network / P2P contract
- Blockchain / consensus lifecycle
- State and data ownership
- MEMORY-001 federation boundary
- Canonical API/interface contract
- Canonical event contract
- Security architecture
- ATCLang / VM boundary
- Aurora authority boundary and AURORA-001 relationship
- World Intelligence / Dialogue / Quest boundaries
- Genesis architecture
- GlobusOS / ShivaCore boundaries
- Interoperability
- Storage / indexing / oracle / compute
- Governance and migration
- Failure / recovery
- Observability / evidence
- Deployment / topology
- Compatibility
- Privacy / data governance
- Resource/economic architecture
- Lifecycle
- Subsystem completeness schema
- Architecture completeness matrix
- Master architecture invariants
- Repository authority map

### Evidence semantics

The contract explicitly preserves:

PRESENT != IMPLEMENTED != TESTED != CI_VERIFIED != E2E_VERIFIED != DEPLOYED

No implementation or CI status is fabricated by the architecture document.

### Scope

This PR adds the canonical contract without replacing component repository SSOTs or making the ecosystem repository a hidden implementation dependency.
